text:
[S1] Is the new model trained yet
[S2] Yes but the loss is still high
[S1] Did you check the audio alignment
[S2] I will look at that now

[S1] This espresso tastes very sour
[S2] Maybe you should grind finer
[S1] I thought the ratio was fine
[S2] Try a longer extraction time

[S1] Are you going to the park today
[S2] Only if it stops raining soon
[S1] I want to practice my kickflips
[S2] Let us go when it dries up

[S1] Did you finish the paper reading
[S2] Almost but the math is hard
[S1] We can discuss it before class
[S2] That sounds like a good plan

[S1] What is for dinner tonight
[S2] I was thinking of making pork
[S1] Should we get some sweet potatoes
[S2] Yes that would be great
